title: Unit Event — Popping in My Heart! — Episode6 Smiley Area

meta.Event Outline: Emu takes part in a discussion with her brothers regarding future operations of the park. However, each idea she puts forth comes up against issues of feasibility, leaving her determined to educate herself. That's when she gets the news of an opportunity to visit Mr. Riley's park...

rows.Line: Riley Dream Park
Compass Center

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
We ended up taking the scenic route, but we're finally here...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Do you guys see her parents?
Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Lost Girl
rows.Line: Mommy! Daddy!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh...!
That must be her mom.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, and it sounds like her name's Mary!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Also, I'm glad she was able to find them right away.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, her mother seems relieved as well.

rows.Speaker: Girl's Mother
rows.Line: Thank you so much for taking care of our daughter!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She's thanking us for looking after her.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe! You're welcome!
I'm glad everything worked out, Mary!

rows.Speaker: Mary
rows.Line: Thank you, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh!

rows.Speaker: Mary
rows.Line: That was a fun adventure!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, did she just...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, she thanked Emu for taking her on such a fun adventure.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe...!
I had fun too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<That was beautiful!
She was all smiley in the end!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Yes, she was.
She must've been so happy to see her parents.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Yeah!
A happy ending for everyone♪>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It took us a little while but, yes, we managed to accomplish our goal!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: To be fair, I was pretty worried about what would happen after she cemented herself in front of that roller coaster...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: On the other hand, our splendid little guide here taught us quite a bit about this place.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh no...!
It's almost time for us to meet Mr. Riley!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What? Already? We should hurry.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We'll find him at the “Smiley” area, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “Smiley”... As famous as it is, I didn't realize it was one of Riley Entertainment's works...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's go, you guys! Hurry!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I wanna get there as fast as we can and ask him lots and lots of questions!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?! Emu, wait...!
“Smiley” area

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Where's Mr. Riley...? Oh, there he is!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, he's in front of the merry-go-round. Mr. Riley!

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line:
Hello there!
Did you get to enjoy the park?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! We had a wonderful time going around your park today!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
We certainly did.
It's easy for anyone to strive to make everybody smile...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But this park goes above and beyond that. It's a truly marvelous place.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I agree.
Literally everyone seemed to be smiling or laughing.

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line:
That's wonderful to hear!
I'm glad I invited you all here today.

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: Also, you mentioned that you had some questions for me. Ask away...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, me! Pick me!

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line:
Aren't you an energetic one?
Fire away, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I realized today that this is the “smiliest place in the world” after experiencing everything firsthand!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It was clear that you put lots and lots of thought into how to make it so everyone who visits would smile...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, um... I...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I want to ask how and when you “know” that you're making the right decisions.

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line:
I see...
That's a very good question, young lady.

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: For instance, the “Jungle Music” area posed a significant challenge for us.

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: We wished to provide the experience of adventuring through a “real jungle”, which initially led me to attempting to plant trees from an actual rainforest here.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, real ones?

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: Yes. My goal was to have our visitors have fun while getting a chance to walk in the shoes of the characters from that movie.

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: Unfortunately, budget constraints prevented that from happening. It would've cost far too much to care for tropical trees in this climate.

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: On top of that, the main area required more help than I realized, which left me shorthanded.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(*Gasp*
The same thing happened to us...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So your park doesn't always have the resources it needs, Mr. Riley?

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: Of course. The movie itself did very well, but there are always limits in terms of manpower and funding.

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: As a result, we had to scrap our idea for bringing a “real jungle” here.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It sounds like you didn't have much of a choice...

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: But it's not like we completely gave up.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: How do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: We consulted with some botanists regarding how we could simulate the real thing. Those trees may be manmade, but they help create a very jungle-like atmosphere.

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: Thanks to them, we were able to come very close to what we wanted. After that, we just had to build some waterfalls and research what jungles sound and even smell like.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What they smell like...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
But these trees are imitations...
And yet, it feels like we've wandered into a real jungle for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now I understand...

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: We've been fortunate enough to be able to construct an artificial jungle that all of our visitors can safely enjoy.

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: We had to perform a balancing act between our goals and what was actually possible. By doing so, we were able to create this wonderful place.

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: I'm sorry, it's someone from the office. You'll have to excuse me for a minute...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What's wrong, Emu...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh?
N-N-Nothing!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
There's no way that's true.
Your smile's turned upside down.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I noticed that you were hurriedly writing down quite a few notes while our little friend took us around the park.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We've discussed this before, haven't we...? If something's bothering you, please tell us.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry, you guys!
I didn't mean to hide anything from you...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's just... He's so amazing...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Who? Mr. Riley...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah. It's like he always “knows” what to do to move forward even if he doesn't have what he needs...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And how I'm nothing like him...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Where's this coming from?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: For as long as I can remember, I kept saying that I'm going to make the Wonder Stage and Phoenix Wonderland “a place that makes everyone smile”.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I didn't actually know what to do until you guys came along...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You came up with the idea of us doing a night show, didn't you...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
No!
That was just something that was floating around in my head. You're the one who made it a reality, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
And it's not just you.
Nene made everyone smile with her singing.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa used his sparkly powers to convince the other cast members to help us, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: While I... I just had my head in the clouds...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I couldn't help even when it came to trying to convince my own brothers...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Emu...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's why I've been trying really hard to learn how you guys, including Mr. Riley, are able to make everyone's dreams come true.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So it's true that I had a lot on my mind, and I'm sorry for making you guys worry so much...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I agree that being able to make everyone's dreams come true is very important...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But, Emu, you...

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: That settles that! Thank you for waiting!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line:
Hm? Is something the matter?
It's like a somber mood's come over all of you...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, well... We were discussing something and...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
W-We'll be fine!
We can discuss this later!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Right...!
We'll hammer this out when we have more time.

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line:
Are you sure?
Well, if you say so...

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: Anyway, I had you all meet me here today because of what I've been meaning to show you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Show us?

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: Yes, it's this...
